_comment: Pass/fail limits for make hwtest. Provisional: the project spec sets no numbers, so these are reasonable targets for a 24-bit codec chain behind an analog front end. Tighten or loosen them once the first boards are measured. Each check names a value in results.json by its path.

checks.name: Loopback cable found
checks.why: Most tests need an output jack cabled to the input jack

checks.name: SNR, A-weighted
checks.why: Full-scale output over the idle noise floor

checks.name: Noise increase under CPU load
checks.why: Digital activity coupling into the analog rails

checks.name: No clipping up to 0 dBFS out
Round-trip latency
checks.why: Two 1 ms blocks plus the codec's filters; players notice from about 10 ms

checks.name: No dropouts in 12 s under load
No overruns in the test firmware
Volume knob noise
checks.why: The main firmware reports knob moves of 2 % or more

checks.name: Main firmware: worst callback
checks.why: The budget is 1000 us per 48-sample block
